prompts:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: transparent RGBA two-character medieval RPG dialogue sprite atlas, one landscape canvas with TWO equal vertical columns (each column a tall 3:4 portrait region).
Input image 1 is the edit target and identity/style reference. Preserve the faces, painterly realism and wardrobes of ONLY its top-left Aelor and top-right Isha. Recompose those two people as true WAIST-UP HALF-BODY figures, each showing the full head, neck, shoulders, both upper arms, both forearms, naturally posed hands, entire torso, and waist/belt. Aelor stands in the left column facing slightly right; Isha stands in the right column facing slightly left. End both figures just BELOW the waist, with the belt and hands clearly above the bottom edge. Their faces should occupy about the top quarter of each figure's height, with the substantial torso and arm anatomy occupying the remaining height. Keep each complete silhouette within its own column with generous transparent padding on every side and a transparent gutter between columns.
Aelor: same young male face and brown hair visible at his forehead, worn forest-green medieval cloth hood and coordinated green tunic, simple brown leather straps and waist belt, relaxed hands near his waist. Isha: same young brown-haired female face, plain grey medieval dress with off-white linen bonnet/coif and gathered pale neckline, naturally resting hands together near her waist. Match the established inward gazes and muted cloth colors. Draw their extended bodies coherently in the same detailed painted style as their reference faces.
Output composition: two separate tall half-body sprites, side by side, ideally a 1536x1024 landscape atlas. Genuine alpha transparency outside both figures and through the central gutter. Preserve transparent background; no solid matte, scenery, simulated checkerboard, text, labels, UI frames or captions. Do not include the two bottom-row men from the reference. Avoid head-only, shoulders-only, bust, chest-level truncation, enlarged face crops, cut-off elbows or hands, merged silhouettes, modern weapons, armor redesigns or additional characters. The essential correction is full waist-up anatomy and tall portrait framing.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image 1 is the edit target: two true waist-up medieval dialogue sprites. Preserve BOTH faces exactly, the inward gazes, green-hooded Aelor's wardrobe, grey-dressed bonneted Isha's wardrobe, their current hand poses, all full half-body anatomy and painterly realism. Change only spacing and transparent padding.
Keep one 1536x1024 landscape RGBA atlas with two equal 768x1024 columns. Scale each complete figure down slightly, centered within its own column, so the left figure's entire visible silhouette including elbows, forearms, hands, belt and clothing ends fits inside x=40..720 and y=40..970, and the right figure fits inside x=816..1496 and y=40..970. Show clothing to just below the waist and hands; the base of each waist-up cutout must end ABOVE the bottom padding, not at the canvas edge. Keep at least 40 pixels of fully transparent margin along all outer canvas edges and on both sides of the vertical boundary x=768. The gutter x=728..808 must be genuinely transparent for its entire height, with no sleeve, hand, hair, shadow or painted glow crossing it. Avoid clipping or truncating either figure to manufacture the padding: retain the complete currently visible upper arms, elbows, forearms, hands and waist. Do not shrink to head-and-shoulders or bust framing.
Remove any background color or studio haze from the actual alpha outside the silhouettes. Preserve clean natural cloth/hair edges and genuine RGBA transparency. No opaque matte, checkerboard, scenery, labels, text or UI. Both half-body figures remain separate game sprites, not a composed scene.
